title: With HQ installed on an Android phone, the alert pop-up never appears, yet HQ says alerts are on
what: HQ makes its pop-up in the old desktop way. Chrome on Android refuses that way for a page and only allows a pop-up made through the installed app's background helper. HQ catches the refusal and writes it only to the hidden console, while the Alerts card keeps saying a short sound and a pop-up come when something new needs you.
expected: On the phone the pop-up shows (made through the background helper), or the Alerts card says plainly that pop-ups do not work on this phone.
how_often: every alert while HQ is used on an Android phone
fix_line: Show the pop-up through the background helper when there is one, and say so if the phone refuses

title: The alert sound stays silent until you click somewhere in HQ after opening it
what: The sound is made by the minute timer, not by a tap. Browsers keep page sound muted until the person has clicked or typed on the page since it opened. So after HQ is opened or reloaded and left alone in a tab, new leads and help questions arrive with no sound, even though the Alerts card says a short sound comes.
expected: The sound is unlocked once by the Turn on alerts tap or the first click, or HQ says the sound needs one click after opening.
how_often: every time HQ is opened and not clicked
fix_line: Unlock the sound on the first click and say when it is still locked

title: An HQ pop-up stays on screen after the job in it is done
what: When a lead is called or a help question answered, the pop-up that announced it is not taken away; it stays in the computer's or phone's notification list until clicked or a newer one replaces it. It also lists every new kind in one pop-up but a click opens only the first.
expected: Once the counts behind a pop-up go back to zero, HQ closes it.
fix_line: Close the last pop-up when Needs you no longer has what it announced

title: After a feedback reply HQ says their phone got a pop-up when it only knows the message was handed over
what: When a reply is sent and Google accepts the phone message, HQ says the person's phone got a pop-up. Whether it shows depends on the phone: notifications allowed for the app, the phone maker's battery and banner rules, and the app still installed. HQ cannot know any of that.
expected: The note says the pop-up was sent to their phone, not that the phone got it.
how_often: every reply to someone whose app can take a pop-up
fix_line: Change the words to sent to their phone

title: A message to every gym shows no sign of which gyms have seen it
what: Messages says each message reaches every gym's bell within a minute. It only reaches a gym whose admin app is open, and HQ shows nothing per gym: not how many saw it, nor which gyms never opened the admin app since.
expected: Each sent message shows how many gyms have seen it so far.
fix_line: Count gyms that opened each message and show the number
